title: JFarwell Private Yacht Wine & Cheese Sunset Sail
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This sunset sail is a stunning opportunity to see how Halifax's urban and nature connect. Guests will be greeting with their first Nova Scotia wine upon boarding, and then set sail. With the engines off and fully under wind power, Captain and crew will invite you to be as involved as you'd like with the sailing process. Enjoy learning about each glass, grown and perfectly crafted in our own backyard. Set sail into the Northwest Arm to see the Dingle Tower, lush parks and stunning homes as the sun sets. An evening you will never forget!
